title: Week 10 Monday card
verification_note: Lines are DraftKings' exact numbers via The Odds API at 21:09 UTC 2026-11-16, Pinnacle as reference. Injuries, weather, splits from search (UNVERIFIED); inactives post 6:45 PM ET, after build. No DK odds boost found.

tickets.name: Over 40.5 -115

legs.label: Over 40.5
legs.why: combined_edge -0.016 (Rule B). Pin fair 51.9% at 40.5; own 54.0%, within 6 points of Pin.

tickets.why: Own 54.0% vs 53.5% breakeven, Pin fair 51.9%. Total already fell 42 to 40.5 at Pinnacle on the short-week-under story and Pinnacle now shades the Over at -115 at the same number. Every Giants skill player practiced full, Daniels healthy, Washington starts a backup center. Thin lean, best-rated side on the game.
tickets.kill_switch: Total 41.5+ or worse than -120 before placing: skip, move $10 to Commanders ML if +100 or better, else Giants -1.5 at -115 or better. McCarthy or Daniels inactive at 6:45 PM: skip, move $10 to Under 40.5 at -110 or better. If already placed, keep.

tickets.name: Commanders ML +105

legs.label: Commanders ML
legs.why: combined_edge -0.018 (Rule B). Pin fair 46.9%; own 49.5%, within 6 points of Pin.

tickets.why: Own 49.5% vs 48.8% breakeven, Pin fair 46.9%. Both books moved toward Washington since Tuesday (Pin ML +120 to +108, DK spread 2.5 to 1.5) against a fully healthy Giants team. Divisional rematch of a tie at a 1.5-point line. Not an SGP: dog plus under would need the Under against the core Over, favorite plus over would reuse the Over leg. Profit Boost token here.
tickets.kill_switch: Shorter than +100 or Daniels inactive: skip, move $5 to the Over (ticket becomes $15). If already placed, keep unless Daniels is out.

tickets.name: Titans ML +490

legs.label: Titans ML
legs.why: combined_edge +0.014 (Rule B, 0.001 short of A). Pin fair +444 (18.4%) vs DK +490 (16.9%); own 18.5%.

tickets.why: Best price on the board: DK hangs +490 while Pinnacle is +427 on the dog, and DK pushed Jaguars ML from -600 to -675 while Pinnacle went the other way (-556 to -533). Divisional road favorite of 10.5 is the public side; big favorites cover and win less than the market's chalk implies. EV +8.6% before the token, about +31% with a 25% Profit Boost.
tickets.kill_switch: Shorter than +440 before placing: skip. Titans starting QB inactive at 11:30: skip. Freed money goes, in order, to Jets +8.5 at -118 or better, then Dolphins ML at +180 or longer (both games carry $0 today). If already placed, keep.

tickets.name: Browns +4.5 -108

legs.label: Browns +4.5
legs.why: combined_edge +0.003 (Rule B). Pin +4 at 50.2% fair; the hook adds about 1.5 points (push at 4), so Pin-implied about 51.7%; own 53.0%.

tickets.why: DK sits a half point off Pinnacle (+4.5 vs +4) in a 40.5-total game where every point is worth more. Cleveland forecast ranges from mild to 19 mph wind and 68% rain (sources disagree, UNVERIFIED); bad weather shrinks margins and favors the dog. Small edge, so $15 not $20.
tickets.kill_switch: +4 or worse, or worse than -115 at +4.5: skip. Browns starting QB inactive: skip. Freed money goes, in order, to Jets +8.5 at -118 or better, then Dolphins ML at +180 or longer (both games carry $0 today). If already placed, keep.

tickets.name: Cowboys +4.5 -112

legs.label: Cowboys +4.5
legs.why: combined_edge +0.002 (Rule B). Pin +4 at 51.0% fair, hook worth about 1.7 points, Pin-implied about 52.7%; own 53.5%.

tickets.why: DK moved 49ers -3.5 to -4.5 since Tuesday while Pinnacle never left -4, so DK is shading the public favorite and the dog gets a free half point. Home dog off the 4 key-ish number. Thin, so $10.
tickets.kill_switch: +4 or worse, or worse than -120: skip. Cowboys QB inactive: skip. Freed money goes, in order, to Jets +8.5 at -118 or better, then Dolphins ML at +180 or longer (both games carry $0 today). If already placed, keep.

tickets.name: Unders: 49ers-Cowboys / Vikings-Packers

legs.label: Under 55.5
legs.why: combined_edge -0.011 (Rule B). Pin Under 56 -112 (51.4%); 55.5 turns 56 into a loss, about 50.6% Pin-implied; own 51.5% vs 50.5% breakeven. Pairs with Cowboys +4.5 (dog plus under), the one correlated pair for this game.

legs.label: Under 42.5
legs.why: combined_edge -0.006 (Rule B). Pin 42 (50.9% under), DK gives a half point; own 54.0%: Kirk Cousins starts five days after the trade from Las Vegas, Murray out, Vikings missing key pieces (Star Tribune).

tickets.why: Two unders where DK gives at least Pinnacle's number. New-QB install for Minnesota caps their offense; the Dallas under rides the Cowboys-dog script.
tickets.kill_switch: Vikings-Packers 41.5 or lower: swap that leg for Over 40.5 Seahawks-Raiders -108. 49ers-Cowboys 54.5 or lower: swap for Jets +8.5 -118. Cousins inactive: drop the Vikings leg and play the other as a $10 single.

tickets.name: Chiefs-Falcons Over / Raiders +6.5

legs.label: Over 47.5
legs.why: combined_edge -0.004 (Rule B). Pin fair 50.8% at 47.5 with Over shaded -110; own 52.5%. Mahomes full practice all week after the clean elbow MRI (Rotoballer, KY3), dome game.

legs.label: Raiders +6.5
legs.why: combined_edge -0.013 (Rule B). Pin fair 51.0% at +6.5; own 52.5%. Seattle starts Drew Lock (oblique plus elbow, limited every week since Week 6) with Milroe behind him; Darnold out.

tickets.why: Total moved 45.5 to 47.5 at both books on Mahomes news and Pinnacle still leans Over. Raiders get a banged-up backup QB under the 7 key number.
tickets.kill_switch: Chiefs-Falcons total 48.5 or higher: drop that leg and play Raiders +6.5 as a $10 single. Raiders +6 or worse: swap that leg for Raiders ML at +230 or longer. Mahomes inactive: drop the Over leg. Lock inactive (Milroe starts): keep, the Raiders leg improves.

tickets.name: Rams-Cards Under / Panthers +1.5 / Steelers ML

legs.label: Under 38.5
legs.why: combined_edge -0.011 (Rule B). Pin 38 (49.8% under); 38.5 wins on 38 too, about 50.8% Pin-implied; own 53.5%: Arizona on a rookie third-stringer (Carson Beck expected, Minshew on IR, Brissett traded) and Rams without Nacua (Arizona Sports, UNVERIFIED).

legs.label: Panthers +1.5
legs.why: combined_edge -0.008 (Rule B). Pin Panthers +1 (50.7%); the hook turns a 1-point loss into a win, about 52.4% Pin-implied; own 54.0%.

legs.label: Steelers ML
legs.why: combined_edge -0.014 (Rule B). Pin fair 37.1% (+170); own 39.0%. Both 6-2, Pittsburgh won the Week 3 meeting 30-27 (Squawka).

tickets.why: Longest ticket, so the No Sweat token goes here (EV moves from about -2.5% to +60% with the refund). Each leg is DK at or within a hair of Pinnacle.
tickets.kill_switch: Rams-Cards 37.5 or lower: swap that leg for Cardinals ML +370 or longer. Panthers +1 or worse: swap that leg for Dolphins ML +180 or longer. Steelers shorter than +150: swap for Steelers +3.5 at -110 or better. Cardinals start someone other than Beck: re-read the Under leg.

tickets.name: Under 39.5 -112

legs.label: Under 39.5
legs.why: combined_edge -0.015 (Rule B). Pin 39 (49.3% under, about 50.6% at 39.5 with the hook); own 54.0%, within 6 points of Pin.

tickets.why: Own 54.0% vs 52.8% breakeven. DK moved 38.5 to 39.5 and sits a half point above Pinnacle's 39 after 70%+ of tickets hit the Over. Brissett's first Baltimore start and a Chargers receiving room missing McConkey (and likely Njoku) both lean low. Clear, 43 F, light wind.
tickets.kill_switch: 39 or lower, or worse than -120 before placing: skip, move $10 to Chargers +4.5 (ticket becomes $15). Herbert inactive at 6:45 PM: keep. If already placed, keep.

tickets.name: Chargers +4.5 -108

legs.label: Chargers +4.5
legs.why: combined_edge -0.019 (Rule B). Pin +4.5 at 50.0% fair; own 53.0%, within 6 points of Pin.

tickets.why: Own 53.0% vs 51.9% breakeven. In a sub-40 total each point is worth more, and a new-to-the-team backup QB caps Baltimore's margin. Dog plus under is the game's one correlated pair, built as two straights (no SGP repricing, Under leg not reused).
tickets.kill_switch: +4 or worse, worse than -115, or Herbert inactive: skip, move $5 to the Under (ticket becomes $15). If already placed, keep.

watch: Inactives 6:45 PM ET: Herbert out kills ticket 2 ($5 moves to the Under). Brissett out keeps both.
Under 39.5 at -120 or better only. 39 or lower: skip, $10 to Chargers +4.5.
Chargers +4.5 at -115 or better only. +4: skip, $5 to the Under.
McConkey and Njoku statuses (sources conflict): both out strengthens the Under.
Next: Tuesday early card for Week 11 grades Monday.

board.read: Under 39.5 $10, Chargers +4.5 $5 (dog plus under as straights).
